"import cadquery as cq

# Create the base plate: 100 (X) x 60 (Y) x 8 (Z)
# Centered on origin in XY, base face at z=0, thickness along Z
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(100, 60, 8, centered=(True, True, False))

# Select the four vertical edges (parallel to Z axis)
vertical_edges = plate.edges("|Z").vals()

# Fillet all four vertical edges with radius 8
result = plate.fillet(8, vertical_edges)

# Add four through holes of diameter 6, axes parallel to Z, through full thickness
# Centered at (+/-35, +/-15)
result = (result.faces(">Z").workplane()
          .pushpoints([(35, 15), (-35, 15), (35, -15), (-35, -15)])
          .circle(3)
          .cutThruAll())

# Export the final single solid to part.step in the current working directory
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")"
